note: How tall each sedge's leaves and seed heads are drawn (0.9.140). heightIn is the height in flower, and the tallest of leaves and heads is drawn to it. Where Mt. Cuba's Carex trial measured the taxon (average foliage height and flower height, mtcubacenter.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Carex-Website-Data-.xlsx), the shorter of the two is drawn at the trial's ratio of heightIn when they differ by more than 15%. Without a trial row the leaves stand between 0.86 of heightIn, the trial's lower quartile of foliage over flower height, and heightIn, except where the record says the flowers stand well above the leaves. A sedge with no heads drawn is its leaves. Heights are measured from the ground each tuft stands on, not the on-screen top, which a wide clump lifts by the depth of its back edge. Tolerance: 10% or 2 in, as for the grasses. Checked by "every sedge draws at its sourced height" in tests/game.test.js.
